subject: Oceanography
title: Coral Reef Decline
description: A short lesson to help you apply Coral Reef Decline.

hook.text: Half of the world's coral reefs have died since 1950—from warming, pollution, and destructive fishing.

buildup.text: Reefs cover less than 1% of the ocean floor—but support 25% of all marine species.

discovery.text: Blast fishing and cyanide fishing destroy reef structure in minutes—practices still common in parts of Southeast Asia.

twist.text: Even 'pristine' reefs are stressed—ocean warming and acidification reach everywhere, no reef is immune.

climax.text: 500 million people depend on reefs for food, income, and storm protection—their loss is a humanitarian crisis.

punchline.text: Reefs support a quarter of ocean life on less than 1% of the floor.

quiz.question: How much of the ocean floor do coral reefs cover?
